h: Ballon d'Or organisers reportedly issue statement after winners were mistakenly published hours before ceremony
p: Organisers of the Ballon d'Or have reportedly responded after the winners appeared online before the ceremony took place. The mix-up has drawn heavy reaction from football fans, and several Nigerian players are among those in the conversation.
more: Some star players are reported to have skipped the ceremony.
Fans are debating whether the published list was accurate.
